title: Pistachio Baklava: Thick Green Pistachio Layer Squares
changes_from_base: All pistachio instead of walnut and pistachio, ground finer with cardamom and packed into one thick green layer; a plain lemon sugar syrup replaces the honey syrup, it bakes hotter on a low shelf, and each square is topped with ground pistachio.
summary: A thick single layer of finely ground pistachio and cardamom between buttered filo, baked crisp, soaked in lemon syrup and topped with more pistachio.

ingredients.item: shelled unsalted pistachios, bright green if possible

steps.title: Make the syrup
steps.text: Bring the sugar and water to the boil in the small pan, stirring until dissolved. Add the lemon juice and simmer for 6-8 min until slightly syrupy. Add the orange blossom water if using and leave to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Grind the pistachios
steps.text: Pulse the pistachios to a fine crumb that still has some texture; stop before it turns oily. Set aside 4 tbsp for the top and mix the rest with the sugar and cardamom.

steps.title: Prepare the oven and pastry
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) with a shelf in the lower third, so the bottom layers crisp. Trim the filo to fit the dish and keep it under the damp towel.

steps.title: Lay the base
steps.text: Brush the dish with butter. Layer half the filo, brushing every second sheet with butter.

steps.title: Add the filling
steps.text: Spread all the pistachio mixture over the base in one thick, even layer and press it down firmly with your palms.

steps.title: Top and cut
steps.text: Cover with the remaining filo, buttering every second sheet, and brush the top generously. Cut right through to the base into 24 squares (6 x 4), then pour any leftover butter over the cuts.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake on the low shelf for 40-50 min until golden on top. Lift a corner of a middle square with a knife: the bottom layers should be crisp and golden. If the top darkens before the base is ready, lay foil loosely over it.

steps.title: Soak and garnish
steps.text: Run the knife along the cuts again, then pour the cooled syrup evenly over the hot baklava. Spoon a small mound of the reserved pistachios onto the centre of each square and leave to cool for at least 4 h before serving.

tips: Peeled Persian or Sicilian pistachios give the brightest green colour.
Pulse in short bursts so the nuts do not release their oil and clump.
A metal dish conducts heat better than glass and gives a crisper base.
storage: Keep loosely covered at room temperature for up to 5 days. Do not refrigerate. Freezes well for up to 3 months.
